fusion_rules.rule: Apply Vitest configuration, workers, fixtures, mocks, timers, snapshots, type tests, coverage, and CLI controls.
Accept only: A JavaScript or TypeScript unit or integration test project using Vitest.
Produce only: Runnable Vitest tests and configuration, not the cross-layer portfolio strategy.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: A JavaScript or TypeScript unit or integration test project using Vitest.
output_boundary: Runnable Vitest tests and configuration, not the cross-layer portfolio strategy.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: Vitest 核心定位与能力特性：基于 Vite 构建的高性能单元测试框架，兼容 Jest API，支持原生 ESM/TS/JSX、智能监听、多线程执行与覆盖率; Vitest 基础配置方法：通过 vitest.config.ts 使用 defineConfig 声明测试参数与选项; Vite 现有配置集成方法：使用 mergeConfig 工具将现有 vite.config 与 Vitest 测试配置融合
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 用于前端、Node.js 及全栈 TypeScript/JavaScript 项目单元与集成测试; 独立 Vitest 配置文件的标准化声明; 项目中存在既有 Vite 配置时避免配置冗余或冲突
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 8 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (method=6, rule=2); each is bound to an exact source citation.
